$comment: first-content's budget is 6000 ms, not 2500: on CI's runners unchanged pages measure 2.5 to 4.64 s from one run to the next (/lab/story/, /lab/model-reviews/gemini/, /ouro-md/download/ and /lab/how-desk-started/ at 3840, runs 42687903505 to 42728469008), so 6000 ms gates a real regression without failing on the runner. Each waiver below names its page and its measurement.

/.first-content: Its largest content is the workshop video's first frame, which waits for the video file: 5.17 to 5.43 s at 390 in every run (runs 42687903505 to 42728469008), close to the 6000 ms budget.

/housesitter/.first-content: Its largest content is the workshop video's first frame, which waits for the video file: 5.37 to 16.36 s at 1440 and 3840 (runs 42687903505 to 42728469008).

/blog/build-ai-agent-from-scratch/.first-content: Its largest content at 3840 is a transcript far below the fold, drawn only when the check scrolls the page to look for overlaps: 13.08 s light and 17.38 s dark (run 43153514247).

/origin/.first-content: It redirects to /blog/build-ai-agent-from-scratch/, whose largest content at 3840 is a transcript far below the fold, drawn only when the check scrolls the page to look for overlaps: 13.08 s light and 17.38 s dark (run 43153514247).

/lab/docs/architecture/.layout-shift: The h1's second clause rewraps on a 390-wide phone when Cormorant loads: 0.109 against the 0.1 budget, the same in every run (runs 42687903505 to 42728469008).

/blog/.baked-corner: The night gatefold scene's hero (scenes/gatefold-dark, .github#119–#149) paints a daisy against a tree trunk in its top-left corner and a firefly in its bottom-left, both right on the corners' diagonals, so the corner reading sees a band of another colour; the corners are the frame's own, clean at 1440×900@2x (run 43766879079, findings/blog-1-raw.png).
